name: Do new windows come with a warranty?

mainEntity.name: Do new windows come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most new windows come with manufacturer warranties that cover defects in materials and workmanship, often ranging from 10 years to lifetime coverage. Our installation work is also backed by a separate labor warranty. Specific warranty details vary by manufacturer and product line, and we will provide all relevant warranty information for your chosen windows.
acceptedAnswer.description: New windows typically come with manufacturer warranties covering materials and workmanship, and our installation includes a labor warranty.
